scope: Offline CREMA-D low-level features, fully trained small NumPy recurrent encoders; not causal media streaming or full HX network
cfc_mode: default; backbone_layers=0; no sparsity; independent NumPy BPTT
time_contract: physical_dt=0.1*stored_dt; all models see identical time and masks
analytic_gate: erfc((softplus(-z)+0.001)/(3*sqrt(2*physical_dt))); zero-drift first passage under frozen gap each step
matched_c1: logistic with analytic value and z-derivative matched exactly at z=0 separately for each physical dt

training.validation: half budget and final; minimum full-condition validation CE; earlier on ties

training_augmentation: Each batch uses gap0,8,32 uniformly; during gap show a random training clip as irrelevant distractor. Per sample, drop audio with p0.1 or video with p0.1, disjoint. Retain target phase and query bits. All arms share seed-indexed batch/distractor/mask prefix.
long_memory_scope: Artificial recall of first real clip after other real-clip distractors; not naturally labeled long video. delay96 is outside training gap range.
selection: Only training and validation arrays before selected checkpoint hash is sealed. Existing historical test cohort is reused, not fresh independent confirmation; earlier aggregate test results are already known.
statistics: Report actor-balanced accuracy, CE and Brier. Paired crossed resampling of 3 seeds and 8 test actors, 5000 replicates; descriptive intervals. Equal-CPU primary contrasts analytic vs four controls for full and mean missing_audio/missing_video, 8 contrasts; one-sided lower quantile0.05/8 and gain>=0.02 required per contrast.
cost: Full process CPU/wall/RSS and nested training CPU; shared restore separately. No GPU or energy measurements. Parameter matched CfC within3%; same-width CfC separately reported. Arithmetic FLOPs count affine matmuls only, not special functions or memory traffic.
exclusions: No claim of foundation model scale, full HX financial kernel, optimized hardware competitiveness, learned raw-media frontend, or all-blocker closure
